7.title: Page Results: count slice
7.description: Write `page_items(items, count)` to return the first `count` items; return an empty list when count is negative.
7.learningObjective: Use a variable stop index to return a requested prefix length.
instructions: Define `page_items(items, count)`.
Return an empty list when count is below 0.
Otherwise slice from the start to `count`.
Check zero and a count longer than the list.

workedExample.explanation: A variable stop index makes a slice reusable for pagination. The explicit negative check prevents Python’s negative-stop behavior from returning an unintended prefix.
